feed.title: SLB, Formentera Working to Activate Drilling Rigs in Venezuela, Executives Say
feed.summary: Oil service provider SLB and private equity firm Formentera Partners are actively working to reactivate or import drilling rigs into Venezuela to boost its crude production capacity. Despite current obstacles like importing equipment and negotiating with the Venezuelan government, SLB anticipates reactivating up to 15 rigs within a year, with a few expected to be operational by year-end, while Formentera is in discussions with international service providers for additional rigs. This effort comes as Venezuela seeks to expand its oil production, though challenges related to power supply, supply chains, and contract protection remain.

feed.title: US Eyes $4B Loan for Vistra Nuclear Upgrades
feed.summary: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing a $4 billion loan package for Vistra Corp. to upgrade three of its nuclear plants, two in Ohio and one in Pennsylvania. The formal announcement could come as early as Monday during Energy Secretary Chris Wright's visit to the Perry nuclear complex.

feed.title: Treasury Yields Push to Multi-Decade Highs, and History Says They May Climb Further
feed.summary: U.S. Treasury yields have reached multi-decade highs, primarily driven by real rates and stronger growth expectations following the Federal Reserve's September hike. Historical data suggests that long-term yields often continue to rise after initial Fed tightening, especially during periods of elevated inflation. While equity markets have shown resilience, rate-sensitive sectors are beginning to experience pressure from these higher rates.

feed.title: PG&E imposters reported throughout Fresno County
feed.summary: PG&E is warning residents of Fresno County about imposters claiming to be employees who are trying to gain access to customer financial information. These scammers offer to help customers save money by reviewing their bills, which can lead to unauthorized changes and financial theft. PG&E advises customers to ask for identification, call 800-743-5000 to verify employees, and call 911 if they feel threatened or if an imposter tries to enter their home.

feed.title: Disney cuts 300 workers, offers executives early retirement
feed.summary: Walt Disney Co. recently laid off nearly 300 workers, primarily in human resources and technology, as part of an industry-wide consolidation and a "One Disney" restructuring effort led by CEO Josh D’Amaro. The company is also offering early retirement packages to older executives and plans further cuts, particularly in the television division, to adapt to changing consumption patterns and improve efficiency. This move reflects a broader trend of workforce reductions across Hollywood studios as the streaming market matures and cost-cutting becomes a priority.

feed.title: Trump touts American manufacturing at Peterbilt factory
feed.summary: President Donald Trump visited Peterbilt's manufacturing plant in Denton, Texas, to promote his administration's policies as beneficial for truck manufacturers and employees, ahead of the November midterm elections. He touted the growth of American manufacturing jobs and highlighted proposed EPA revisions to nitrogen oxides emissions regulations, claiming they would reduce costs and improve trucks. Trump also rallied support for Senate nominee Ken Paxton, framing environmental and trade policies as wins for the trucking industry.

feed.title: 47 Peoples State Bank employees in Wausau to lose jobs in merger
feed.summary: Forty-seven employees across three Peoples State Bank branches in Wausau will be laid off due to a merger with Bank First Corp. The layoffs, announced in an Oct. 1 notice, are scheduled to occur between December 4 and December 18, 2026, as the banks consolidate duplicative roles. The merger has received regulatory and shareholder approval and is set to finalize on December 4, 2026, after which Peoples State Bank locations will reopen as Bank First.

feed.title: The Case for Gold as an 'All-Weather' Investment
feed.summary: Gold, traditionally seen as a safe haven, is increasingly recognized as an "all-weather strategy" due to its diversification benefits and historical outperformance against the S&P 500 since 2000. John Hathaway of Sprott suggests now is an opportune time for investors to consider gold equities, citing strong operating leverage and potential M&A in the mining sector, regardless of gold's price movements. Investors can gain exposure through ETFs like the Sprott Gold Miners ETF (SGDM) and the Sprott Junior Gold Miners ETF (SGDJ).

feed.title: What Dementia Care Really Costs and How to Prepare
feed.summary: Dementia care is a significant financial burden due to its long duration and increasing care needs as the disease progresses. Costs can range from hundreds of thousands to over a million dollars, with national median monthly expenses for different care types presented. Families typically cover these costs through out-of-pocket payments, long-term care insurance, or Medicaid as a last resort, emphasizing the importance of early financial planning.

feed.title: Stellantis STLA Slides As Downgrades, Battery Shortages Hit Outlook

The company has also faced downgrades from Morgan Stanley and Berenberg, who cited a weak product pipeline, soft cash generation, and refinancing risks. An insider's plan to sell shares further adds to the negative outlook.

feed.title: Find out if your business is eligible for a payment from the $82.5 million Tyson direct beef purchaser antitrust settlement!
feed.summary: Tyson Foods Inc. and Tyson Fresh Meats Inc. have agreed to an $82.5 million settlement in an antitrust class action alleging they conspired with other beef producers to inflate prices. Individuals and entities who directly purchased specific fresh or frozen beef products from Tyson, Cargill, JBS, or National Beef between January 1, 2015, and February 29, 2020, may be eligible for a pro rata payment. The deadline to file a claim is November 30, 2026, and proof of purchase is required.

feed.title: With 5.10 million shares plus cash, ESCO Technologies (ESE) completes its Megger purchase.
feed.summary: ESCO Technologies Inc. (ESE) has completed its acquisition of Megger Group Limited for approximately $2.3 billion, paid with $922 million in cash and 5.10 million common shares. The acquisition was financed through a new credit agreement of approximately $1.0 billion, which also refinanced existing indebtedness and covered transaction costs. As part of the deal, ESCO expanded its board and appointed Jeremy P. Abson as an independent director, while the seller retains certain rights and restrictions related to the consideration shares.

feed.title: Warrants for 19.9% of post-deal stock are part of Elmet Group (ELMT)'s defense investment.
feed.summary: Elmet Group (ELMT) detailed a $450 million Department of War investment, including $200 million at closing and subsequent tranches, along with warrants for 19.9% of post-deal common stock. The investment aims to upgrade U.S. facilities, establish a new European manufacturing base, and secure the tungsten supply chain through strategic partnerships and a DLA contract. The company projects significant revenue growth by 2031 and highlights its role as a critical supplier for U.S. defense, especially given increasing restrictions on materials from China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea.

feed.title: IPower : Annual Report for Fiscal Year Ending June 30, 2026 (Form 10-K)

The company implemented several reverse stock splits and secured convertible note financing while also shifting its strategic focus towards AI infrastructure and managing a limited digital asset treasury. The report highlights the financial results, liquidity, capital resources, and critical accounting policies for the period.

feed.title: How Bloomin' Brands Stock Lost 24.8% Last Month
feed.summary: Bloomin' Brands (NASDAQ:BLMN), the parent company of Outback Steakhouse, saw its stock price drop by 24.8% in September 2026 due to macroeconomic concerns affecting the casual dining sector. The decline occurred in three distinct stages, influenced by commodities inflation, rising labor costs, increased oil prices, and high Treasury yields. Despite a recent upgrade to Neutral from Underweight by JPMorgan, the company's significant debt load and reliance on consumer spending present challenges for a sustained turnaround, with the upcoming third-quarter report being a critical checkpoint for investors.
